cases.name: Jennifer "Jenn" Holmes Warmke
cases.about: Her Go Fund Me said, "She was the biggest light and always helping and praying and looking for the best in everyone she met."
cases.narrative: On 7/6/2023, a driver on Fairway Drive reported that her passenger noticed her body near the spillway of a dam in Grapevine Lake. Burch reportedly told detectives he and Holmes got into an argument on their way to Grapevine Lake on July 5. Burch pulled over on Fairway Drive and allegedly shot Holmes twice in the head and two more times in the chest before dumping her body in the lake.
